notes: Each card pairs a problem with a solution. Difficulty 1 cards appear on Seedling, 1-2 on Sapling, all on Old Growth. Every fact needs a source with a working URL. Add new cards here; the game picks them up automatically.

cards.problem: Data centres need more and more electricity
cards.solution: Power them with clean energy and run efficient software
cards.fact: Data centres used about 415 TWh of electricity in 2024, around 1.5% of the world's total. The IEA expects that to roughly double to about 945 TWh by 2030.

cards.problem: Cooling servers wastes a lot of energy
cards.solution: Let an AI model fine-tune the cooling system
cards.fact: DeepMind's machine-learning system cut the energy Google used for cooling its data centres by up to 40% in tests.
The world produced a record 62 million tonnes of e-waste in 2022, and only 22.3% of it was documented as properly collected and recycled.

source.name: ITU and UNITAR, Global E-waste Monitor 2024

cards.problem: Smoggy air from burning fossil fuels
cards.solution: Switch power grids to renewable energy
cards.fact: In 2019, 99% of the world's population lived where the WHO's air quality guideline levels were not met.
Global average sea level has risen about 21 to 24 cm since 1880, mostly from melting ice and seawater expanding as it warms.

cards.problem: Training huge AI models from scratch
cards.solution: Fine-tune a model that already exists
cards.fact: A 2019 study estimated that training one large language model with an automated architecture search emitted about 284 tonnes of CO2e. That is an upper-end case: a single training run of the same model was estimated at under 0.1 tonnes.

cards.problem: Illegal logging deep in the rainforest
cards.solution: Listen for chainsaws with AI-powered sensors
cards.fact: Rainforest Connection hides recycled, solar-powered phones in trees. Machine learning listens to the audio for chainsaws and logging trucks, then alerts local rangers.

cards.problem: Illegal fishing far out at sea
cards.solution: Track ships with satellite data and machine learning
cards.fact: Global Fishing Watch, started by Oceana, SkyTruth and Google, uses ships' position signals and machine learning to map industrial fishing, and publishes the map for free.

cards.problem: Poachers' snares hidden in wildlife parks
cards.solution: Predict poaching hotspots to guide ranger patrols
cards.fact: PAWS, built by Milind Tambe's team, maps where poaching is likely so rangers can patrol there. In field tests, rangers following it removed a whole roll of elephant snares, and 10 antelope snares before any animals were caught.

cards.problem: Data centres taking a growing share of a country's power
cards.solution: Measure and publish energy use so it can be planned
cards.fact: US data centres used about 4.4% of the country's electricity in 2023, and could use 6.7% to 12% by 2028.

source.name: US Department of Energy (Berkeley Lab report)

cards.problem: Tech's footprint is hard to see
cards.solution: Count the whole supply chain, not just the electricity bill
cards.fact: Once supply chains are fully counted, information and communication technology may cause 2.1% to 3.9% of global greenhouse gas emissions.

cards.problem: Nobody knows what a model really emitted
cards.solution: Publish the footprint, including the hardware
cards.fact: The team behind the open BLOOM language model estimated its final training emitted about 24.7 tonnes of CO2e, and roughly double that when hardware manufacturing and idle power were included.
